title: Write every URN marker with all six segments in canonical order

facts.note: Any in-scope file whose text contains a `URN:` marker, whether the marker is new, edited, or pre-existing and unchanged. Detectable by a plain text scan; no diff or phase observer required.
Emitted by bun_green_traceability_detector when a marker is malformed; the finding must be surfaced to the coder as an activation signal.

fires: A file's `URN:` marker has one, two, three, four or five colon-separated segments (any count below six).
A file's `URN:` marker has seven or more colon-separated segments (any count above six).
A `URN:` marker starts with something other than the literal `component`.
A `URN:` marker contains an empty segment (e.g. `component:w:f::side:layer`).
A pre-existing, unchanged file carries a malformed `URN:` marker.
A coder writes or edits a `URN:` marker.
doesNotFire: A file has no `URN:` marker at all (owned by green-urn-marker).
A marker has six well-formed segments but a segment's value is wrong (e.g. wrong side or layer) — owned by the wagon-feature, name, side and layer rules.

given: A file in scope carries a `URN:` marker (new, edited or pre-existing)
when: the marker is written, edited, or checked
then: The marker reads exactly `component:{wagon}:{feature}:{Name}:{side}:{layer}` — the literal `component` first, then exactly five non-empty segments.
prefer: During GREEN, derive each segment from the plan, filename, execution side, and architectural responsibility.
During GREEN, fix only the malformed or missing segment; keep already-correct identity segments unchanged.
avoid: When fixing URN grammar (do not broaden): inventing placeholder segments.
When fixing URN grammar (do not broaden): renaming implementation artifacts solely to make a guessed URN fit.
When fixing URN grammar (do not broaden): altering plan ownership.
unless: No `URN:` marker: skipped here; owned by `green-urn-marker`.
Segment CONTENT is validated by the wagon-feature, name, side and layer rules; this rule checks shape only.
why: Each segment is a join key against plan/: wagon and feature locate the work item, name the component, side and layer its architectural place. A URN missing a segment resolves to nothing — as unbound as no marker, while LOOKING traceable in review.
evidence: Prove: the current behavioral acceptance passes.
Prove: the URN has the canonical six-segment shape — bun_green_traceability_detector reports no GREEN-URN-002 / BUN-GREEN-URN-PATTERN-001 finding.
verifier_detail: Detector splits the marker text on `:` and requires exactly six segments, the first literally `component`, none empty; any other count (fewer or more) is a finding.
Files with no `URN:` marker are skipped — their finding belongs to `green-urn-marker`; reporting both would double-count one fault. Pre-existing unchanged markers are checked like new ones.
Shape only: segment values are checked by green-urn-wagon-feature, green-urn-name-matches, green-urn-side, green-urn-layer.
Severity 3; disposition strict for this realization (see policy.strict-disposition): every finding of this rule fails the check.

Stack-neutral obligation, Bun-specific detector: realized by validator `bun_green_traceability_detector` (core alias GREEN-URN-002, stack alias BUN-GREEN-URN-PATTERN-001). The detector's coverage is the Bun stack's files; the obligation itself is not language-restricted.

Term six_segment_urn: `component:{wagon}:{feature}:{Name}:{side}:{layer}` — literal `component` plus five non-empty segments. Term join_key: a URN segment used to resolve the file against plan/; a missing segment does not degrade: it resolves to nothing while still looking traceable. A URN missing a segment does not degrade gracefully.
